text: player
Trouble Always Shows Up Uninvited
Ichihime
Ready, nyaa! Master, we can start anytime, nyaa!
Mahjong Soul Shrine
Kinda not sure about this...
It's gonna work, nyaa!
Then... let's do this.
Gintoki Sakata
.........Huh? What is this place? Pretty sure I was just drinking at the tavern seconds ago... The hell's going on?
Summon successful, nyaa!
Whew, that's a relief...
Ichihime?! And you are...?
Gin, long time no see since the friendly match, nyaa! Welcome to One Han City, nyaa! This is Ichihime's master, nyaa!
Nice to meet you, Gin!
Master? One Han City? Oi oi... you can't just drag me out here without an appointment!
I'm a busy guy, you know?//nToday was supposed to be the day I put my entire life savings on the line and turned my life around!
Eh, for real?! Don't tell me you're...
Planning on starting a new business?
Planning something shady?
Are you closing down the Odd Jobs to start a new business?
What? No!//nLike I said, I'm trying to turn my life around, alright? Obviously I'm talking about doing the thing.
The thing?
Can't go into details now, but you get the idea... You know, the thing.
Entire life savings... Don't tell me you're up to no good.
Of course not!//nCan't go into details now, but I can assure you it's legit.
Really, nyaa?
Look me in the eye! Do you see the eyes of a liar?
All I see are dead fish eyes...
You are such a mystery, nyaa.
Anyway, just send me back already...
Gin! We have a favor to ask!
Huh? What's this all of a sudden?
We summoned you here for a reason, nyaa!
Lately, a group called the "Scoundrel Three" has been wreaking havoc across One Han City. They're real troublemakers, nyaa!
We were hoping you could take care of them, nyaa.//nThe reward's really good, nyaa! Master will cover the bill, nyaa!
Huh? Me? You're just telling me now?!//nScrew it... No time to worry about my bank account right now!
On top of that, I'll cover all your expenses in One Han City. So, will you take the job?
This is a once-in-a-lifetime deal, nyaa! Take it already, nyaa!
What is this, a fire sale? It's not like I know those people. Besides, shouldn't your world's problems be handled by its own people?
Well, we're done here. Just send me back to my world already.
By its own people...//nWell, then by your own logic, you have even more reason to take this job.
Huh?
The Scoundrel Three are from your world, nyaa! And you definitely know them, nyaa!
Since they're from your world, you should be the one to take care of them, no?
Checkmated... Well, that's one way to get sober.
I need to give it some thought. Mind if I use your restroom? Drank too much – got an emergency down there...
Knock yourself out.
Back in a minute!
Think he's going to take the job?
No worries, nyaa. I'm sure he will, nyaa!
Well, let's hope so...
It's been more than a minute, nyaa?
Yup. What's going on...?
Oi oi oi! What the hell's going on?!!!
Ah, there he is, nyaa!
My precious part is in crisis!!! Why did it turn into a scoring stick of all things?!!!
Precious part...?!
That can't be real, nyaa! You must be joking, nyaa!
I wish it were a joke! I checked like five times! Even slapped myself thinking it was a dream! But I'm stuck in this nightmare! What kind of cursed madness is this?!
Could it be... something went wrong during the summoning, nyaa?
Hmm, not sure how it happened... but we might be able to fix it.
You think so?!
But in exchange, you're going to take the job...
I'll take it! I'll do whatever you want me to do!//nThe Scoundrel Three, or the Three Morons, whatever, just point me at them! Consider it done!!!
And he's gone just like that...
So glad he agreed, nyaa!
Oi! What're you two dawdling for?! Get moving already!!!
Let's catch up then, Ichihime.
Nyaa nyaa...
What is it?
You summoned two people to help, nyaa... Where's the other one, nyaa?
No time for that now! We'll lose him if we don't hurry up!
Nyaa! Let's go, nyaa!
